items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: And, oh yeah, Joe Alvin then went to California. They left and went to California, and then we went to Dreamland Cafe.

ctx.x: it. But... What in general is the form? Do you recall offhand? Is it a ballad form? No, it's

a rhythm. It's a rhythm. It's a syncopated lick. It's a good riff. It's a good riff, yeah, it was a good riff number. And I just wanted to describe the history. I made a little, it's a little small arrangement, just the chorus and give everybody a lead in harmony so we could switch it around. We played it with Wickers today and then... Oh, I want to tell you, we went down to, after we left the Antinous Cafe, we went down to Louisville with Wycliffe's band. And I'm trying to think who we had on trumpet down there.…
the trumpeter? The little George Mitchell.
